311: async fn preflight_for(
312:     tx: &mut Transaction<'_, Postgres>,
313:     run: &RunHead,
314: ) -> Result<ClosePreflight, LifecycleError> {
315:     // 1. Every roster line must carry attendance material (source rows or
316:     //    direct events). Lines without any are the blocking refs (fix-links).
317:     let missing_total: i64 = sqlx::query_scalar(
318:         "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payroll_draft_lines \
319:          WHERE run_id = $1 AND attendance_source_row_count = 0 AND attendance_event_count = 0",
320:     )
321:     .bind(run.id)
322:     .fetch_one(tx.as_mut())
323:     .await?;
324:     let missing_refs: Vec<Uuid> = sqlx::query_scalar(
325:         "SELECT id FROM payroll_draft_lines \
326:          WHERE run_id = $1 AND attendance_source_row_count = 0 AND attendance_event_count = 0 \
327:          ORDER BY employee_company, employee_display_name LIMIT $2",
328:     )
329:     .bind(run.id)
330:     .bind(PREFLIGHT_REF_CAP)
331:     .fetch_all(tx.as_mut())
332:     .await?;
333:     // A run with NO lines had `missing_total == 0` and so passed this check
334:     // vacuously: `COUNT(*) WHERE ... = 0` over an empty roster is 0, and 0 == 0.
335:     // Since `can_close` is the AND of the hard checks, an empty run closed on the
336:     // period lock alone, took a 근태 원천 확보 attestation over zero evidence, and
337:     // carried on down the lifecycle. A guard that examines no subject must fail,
338:     // not pass -- the same rule this repository already applies to the canonical
339:     // enforcement floor and the preflight gate sweep.
340:     let roster_total: i64 =
341:         sqlx::query_scalar("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM payroll_draft_lines WHERE run_id = $1")
342:             .bind(run.id)
343:             .fetch_one(tx.as_mut())
344:             .await?;
345:     let attendance = PreflightCheck {
346:         key: "attendance_material",
347:         label_ko: "근태 원천 확보",
348:         ok: roster_total > 0 && missing_total == 0,
349:         warn: false,
350:         note: if roster_total == 0 {
351:             // Distinct from the missing-material note: nothing to attest is a
352:             // different problem from someone lacking attendance, and an attestor
353:             // reading "근태 원천 누락 0명" would reasonably read it as clean.
354:             Some("명세 대상 없음(로스터 0명)".to_owned())
355:         } else {
356:             (missing_total > 0).then(|| format!("근태 원천 누락 {missing_total}명"))
357:         },
358:         blocking_refs: missing_refs,
359:     };
360: 
361:     // 2. An active payroll period lock must cover the whole run period.
362:     let lock_active: bool = sqlx::query_scalar(
363:         "SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM period_locks \
364:          WHERE domain = 'payroll' AND unlocked_at IS NULL \
365:            AND period_start <= $1 AND period_end >= $2)",
366:     )
367:     .bind(run.period_start)
368:     .bind(run.period_end)
369:     .fetch_one(tx.as_mut())
370:     .await?;
371:     let period_lock = PreflightCheck {
372:         key: "period_lock",
373:         label_ko: "급여 기간 동결",
374:         ok: lock_active,
375:         warn: false,
376:         note: (!lock_active).then(|| "급여 동결창(기간 잠금) 미설정".to_owned()),
377:         blocking_refs: Vec::new(),
378:     };
379: 
380:     // 3. Soft warn: pending leave requests overlapping the period may still
381:     //    change attendance figures. Never blocks — surfaced for the attestor.
382:     let pending_leave: Vec<Uuid> = sqlx::query_scalar(
383:         "SELECT id FROM leave_requests \
384:          WHERE status = 'pending' AND start_date <= $1 AND end_date >= $2 \
385:          ORDER BY start_date LIMIT $3",
386:     )
387:     .bind(run.period_end)
388:     .bind(run.period_start)
389:     .bind(PREFLIGHT_REF_CAP)
390:     .fetch_all(tx.as_mut())
391:     .await?;
392:     let leave = PreflightCheck {
393:         key: "pending_leave",
394:         label_ko: "미결 휴가 신청",
395:         ok: true,
396:         warn: !pending_leave.is_empty(),
397:         note: (!pending_leave.is_empty()).then(|| format!("미결 휴가 {}건", pending_leave.len())),
398:         blocking_refs: pending_leave,
399:     };
400: 
401:     let can_close = attendance.ok && period_lock.ok;
402:     Ok(ClosePreflight {
403:         checks: vec![attendance, period_lock, leave],
404:         can_close,
405:     })
406: }
